defmodule ChatServer.WebSocket do
  @moduledoc "WebSocket handler with rate limiting and message retry"

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_requests_per_minute 60
  @retry_max_attempts 3
  @retry_backoff_ms 1000
  @allowed_message_types ["text", "ping", "subscribe", "unsubscribe"]

  defstruct [
    :socket,
    :user_id,
    :rate_counter,
    :rate_window_start,
    :pending_retries,
    :session_store
  ]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      socket: opts[:socket],
      user_id: opts[:user_id],
      rate_counter: 0,
      rate_window_start: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond),
      pending_retries: %{},
      session_store: %{}
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def handle_info({:tcp, _socket, raw_data}, state) do
    case check_rate_limit(state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        process_frame(raw_data, new_state)
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        Logger.warn("Rate limited user #{state.user_id}")
        send_error(state.socket, "rate_limited")
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info({:retry, message_id}, state) do
    case Map.get(state.pending_retries, message_id) do
      nil ->
        {:noreply, state}
      %{attempts: attempts, payload: payload} when attempts < @retry_max_attempts ->
        new_retries = Map.update!(state.pending_retries, message_id, fn entry ->
          %{entry | attempts: attempts + 1}
        end)
        dispatch_message(payload, %{state | pending_retries: new_retries})
      %{attempts: _} ->
        new_retries = Map.delete(state.pending_retries, message_id)
        {:noreply, %{state | pending_retries: new_retries}}
    end
  end

  defp check_rate_limit(state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    window_elapsed = now - state.rate_window_start

    cond do
      window_elapsed > 60_000 ->
        {:ok, %{state | rate_counter: 1, rate_window_start: now}}
      state.rate_counter < @max_requests_per_minute ->
        {:ok, %{state | rate_counter: state.rate_counter + 1}}
      true ->
        {:error, :rate_limited}
    end
  end

  defp process_frame(raw_data, state) do
    case decode_frame(raw_data) do
      {:ok, %{"type" => type} = frame} when type in @allowed_message_types ->
        handle_validated_frame(frame, state)
      {:ok, %{"type" => "session_restore", "session_data" => session_blob}} ->
        restore_session(session_blob, state)
      {:ok, _} ->
        send_error(state.socket, "invalid_message_type")
        {:noreply, state}
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.debug("Frame decode error: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  defp decode_frame(raw_data) do
    case Jason.decode(raw_data) do
      {:ok, decoded} -> {:ok, decoded}
      {:error, _} -> {:error, :invalid_json}
    end
  end

  defp handle_validated_frame(%{"type" => "text", "body" => body}, state) do
    sanitized = sanitize_text(body)
    broadcast(state.user_id, sanitized)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp handle_validated_frame(%{"type" => "ping"}, state) do
    send_frame(state.socket, %{"type" => "pong", "ts" => System.system_time(:second)})
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp handle_validated_frame(%{"type" => "subscribe", "channel" => ch}, state) do
    if valid_channel?(ch) do
      Registry.register(ChatServer.PubSub, ch, state.user_id)
    end
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp handle_validated_frame(%{"type" => "unsubscribe", "channel" => ch}, state) do
    Registry.unregister(ChatServer.PubSub, ch)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp handle_validated_frame(_, state), do: {:noreply, state}

  defp restore_session(session_blob, state) do
    try do
      decoded = Base.decode64!(session_blob)
      session_data = :erlang.binary_to_term(decoded)
      validated_session = validate_session_schema(session_data)
      new_state = %{state | session_store: validated_session}
      Logger.info("Session restored for user #{state.user_id}")
      {:noreply, new_state}
    rescue
      e ->
        Logger.warn("Session restore failed: #{inspect(e)}")
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  defp validate_session_schema(data) when is_map(data) do
    allowed_keys = ["channels", "preferences", "last_seen"]
    Map.take(data, allowed_keys)
  end
  defp validate_session_schema(_), do: %{}

  defp dispatch_message(payload, state) do
    message_id = payload["id"] || generate_id()
    case deliver(state.socket, payload) do
      :ok ->
        {:noreply, state}
      {:error, _reason} ->
        entry = %{attempts: 1, payload: payload}
        new_retries = Map.put(state.pending_retries, message_id, entry)
        Process.send_after(self(), {:retry, message_id}, @retry_backoff_ms)
        {:noreply, %{state | pending_retries: new_retries}}
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_text(text) when is_binary(text) do
    text
    |> String.slice(0, 4096)
    |> HtmlSanitizeEx.strip_tags()
  end
  defp sanitize_text(_), do: ""

  defp valid_channel?(ch) when is_binary(ch), do: Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/, ch)
  defp valid_channel?(_), do: false

  defp send_error(socket, code), do: send_frame(socket, %{"type" => "error", "code" => code})
  defp send_frame(socket, data), do: :gen_tcp.send(socket, Jason.encode!(data))
  defp deliver(socket, payload), do: :gen_tcp.send(socket, Jason.encode!(payload))
  defp broadcast(user_id, msg), do: Registry.dispatch(ChatServer.PubSub, "global", fn entries ->
    for {pid, _} <- entries, do: send(pid, {:broadcast, user_id, msg})
  end)
  defp generate_id, do: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
end
